scene_meta.focus: Queen Eduhauana returns after three thousand four hundred cycles, reviews sensor data proving the Sundering has degraded Giant tribal cohesion by 58% to 81%, and authorizes the deployment of engineered suppression beasts.

scene_meta.focus: Overseer Ninurta inspects the first generation of eight hundred Gruulith—soul-edited stone-flesh beasts created from captured Giants—verifies their absolute obedience, and dispatches them to exterminate the Ash Giants.
scene_meta.continuity: 1 month, 13 days after the orbital return in scene 010.1
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Reveal of the Gruulith genesis chambers and Overseer Ninurta's deployment order against the Ash Giants

scene_meta.location: The Aerie of the Singing Peaks, Ash Giant Territory
scene_meta.participants: Korrhan, Ash Giants of the Aerie, Gruulith swarm
scene_meta.focus: The Gruulith swarm ambushes the isolated Ash Giants on the Singing Peaks; Korrhan realizes the fatal flaw of their isolationist pride and projects a desperate distress call across the kha to the Tidecallers and Forest Giants.
scene_meta.continuity: 33 days after the Gruulith deployment in scene 010.2; leads into the escalation in chapter 011
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Gruulith assault on the Aerie of the Singing Peaks and Korrhan's desperate distress call across the kha to other tribes
